scope: Analysis of all records as the same participant-type units under the requested ideal-assignment scenario; not alteration or factual certification of raw provenance.

Perturbing all source metadata leaves every 5/7/10-parameter model design exactly unchanged

requirements.requirement: Construct and validate models under ideal allocation without channel adjustment.

evidence: 999999 full-record permutations; all eight responses move together
